children: Global robotics solutions provider's Q3 revenue grew 6% yr/yr, beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for Q3 missed analyst expectations
Company expects Q4 2026 EBITDA between $85 mln and $95 mln
Oceaneering sees 2027 EBITDA in the range of $430 mln to $480 mln
Company expects 2027 free cash flow to exceed 2026 forecast
SSR PERFORMANCE - Higher ROV revenue per day, increased Survey activity, and improved margins in Subsea Robotics drove year-over-year improvements
MANUFACTURED PRODUCTS - Revenue growth driven by resolution of a legacy mobility solutions contract, but lower activity and profitability in Grayloc Products weighed on results
CASH GENERATION - Improved operational cash flow and lower tax payments and capital spending supported free cash flow
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is no "strong buy" or "buy", 3 "hold" and 1 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the oil related services and equipment peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Oceaneering International Inc is $47.00, about 6.6% above its October 21 closing price of $44.09
The stock recently traded at 19 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 21 three months ago
